summaryZh: Grassian研究组研究环境界面在分子层次的化学及其影响，包括大气颗粒物、微液滴、纳米材料和室内表面。实验室研究痕量气体的非均相反应、气水界面化学、含铁颗粒及氮氧化物的多相化学，并关注颗粒物与健康的关系。
researchQuestions: 环境界面的分子化学如何影响大气过程与人类健康？

evidence.quote: The Grassian re search group focuses on the chemistry and impacts of environmental interfaces including atmospheric aerosols, aqueous microdroplets, engineered and geochemical nanomaterials, and indoor surfaces.
This website provides an overview of the research explored in the Environmental Interfaces Laboratory, located on the University of California San Diego campus.
Broadly, research in the Grassian group centers on molecular-level laboratory studies aimed at advancing our understanding of the chemistry and global impacts of environmental interfaces.

Current projects span a range of topics, including the heterogeneous chemistry of trace gases—both organic and inorganic—with atmospheric particulate matter and urban surfaces such as mineral dust, sea spray, and indoor surfaces; chemistry within aqueous microdroplets and at the air/water interface; the dissolution, mobilization, and multiphase chemistry of iron-containing particles; sulfur oxidation in aqueous aerosols; multiphase photochemistry of nitrogen oxides, particularly pathways leading to HONO formation in both indoor and outdoor environments; surface chemistry and interactions of biological macromolecules with geochemical nanoparticles; links between particulate matter and human health; and the environmental and health-related applications and implications of nanoscience and nanotechnology.
